title: Humanoid.WalkSpeed
summary: Character movement speed in studs/second (default 16). Change it for sprints, slows, and power-ups — server-side for authority. Pairs with JumpPower/JumpHeight.

explanation.whyItExists: Sprint abilities, swamp-slow zones, speed potions — all are WalkSpeed math.
whenToUse: Buffs/debuffs: modify on the SERVER when events validate
Per-character modifiers on respawn (apply in CharacterAdded)
whenNotToUse: Client-side speed hacks — the server won't trust them and movement is mostly server-owned
As the only anti-cheat: validate plausibility server-side too
tips: Re-apply modifiers in CharacterAdded — respawns reset to defaults
Layer buffs with a small effect system (base × multipliers) instead of raw overwrites
Sprint toggle: 16 → 24, with FOV boost for feel
commonMistakes: Setting WalkSpeed once and losing it on respawn
Two systems overwriting each other's values — use additive/multiplicative state
Trusting client-set speeds for server logic

examples.title: Speed pad with restore
examples.code:
-- Server Script
local pad = workspace.SpeedPad
local BOOST = 32

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
    local character = hit.Parent
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= BOOST then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = BOOST
        task.delay(5, function()
            if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
            end
        end)
    end
end)
